rule: REQ40-H1. Emptiness: a query that has a content token under engine_stopwords but none under engine_stopwords plus a list would take the engine's raw-token fallback, which the simulation does not reproduce; emptiness is checked against every list the rule evaluates (each candidate alone, and every list L the pruning loop produces) over all 500 COMP-03 questions and all 323 NFCorpus queries. A candidate that empties a query on its own is excluded from K. Per-word step: add each candidate w alone to the D3 list; Δall(w) = selection-set questions gained minus lost on session Recall-all@10; ΔnDCG(w) = the NFCorpus nDCG@10 change. Keep: K = {w : Δall(w) ≥ 1}. Combined check on L = D3 list plus K: (a) NFCorpus nDCG@10 ≥ 0.3265 − 0.002 and MRR@10 ≥ 0.5312 − 0.005; (b) for every type, the selection-set session Recall-any@5 count is at least the D3 count minus 1; (c) owner ruling N1, 2026-10-16: point delta ≥ +1 question AND paired-bootstrap CI lower bound ≥ −1 question (bootstrap_ci, seed 404, 10,000 resamples) on Recall-all@10 over the selection set. Pruning: first, while some query is empty under the current L, drop from K the word with the lowest ΔnDCG among the K words in such a query (ties: lower Δall, then alphabetical); then, while (a) or (b) fails, drop from K the word with the lowest ΔnDCG (same ties), apply the emptiness check again, and recheck. Clause (c) is checked once, on the final L. Outcome: if K empties or (c) fails, the verdict is not adopted and H1 makes no engine change.
